feature: Persistent project regression cases and historical experience-release validation reports

behavior.entry: 任务复盘 → 候选优化与发布 → 版本记录 → 查看验证报告
behavior.regressionCases: Saved to the existing project optimization state and inherited by new candidates; publish, discard, restart and rollback preserve the suite. Users can explicitly edit or remove cases.
behavior.validation: Each candidate starts unvalidated. Changed or disabled advice retains previous expectations until the user edits them; regressions block publication.
behavior.legacy: Legacy candidates retain their saved cases. Legacy releases recover cases from immutable published evaluation/comparison evidence without changing old records.
behavior.history: Read-only original evaluation timestamp, evaluator and candidate revision, checks, expected and actual citations, before/after results and context sizes. Rollbacks show the restored original report, not a new validation.
behavior.isolation: Project/release identity and artifact relationship checked; invalid/missing report yields a local error while version history remains available. Disposed/project-switched UI drops late responses.
behavior.scope: Offline matching and source evidence validation only; no model efficacy evaluation or automatic publication.

secretScan.limitation: Pattern and configured-value scan of generated files; no real credential store is read. A zero crash-dump count means no dump was generated.
